steps.content:
May 13, N.F. 116
03:30 PM

EDGE Emergency Meeting

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The latest action reports have been synced. All Underground assaults on the ruin observation stations were successfully repelled. Losses are roughly 20% below projections. As we're starting to map the enemy's operational patterns, intelligence and surveillance teams can now coordinate for effective predictive countermeasures.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The MBCC Chief played a pivotal role in this outcome, particularly in tactical command and threat assessment. EDGE has opened a special channel once again to invite ${PlayerName} to join us. This is both an expression of gratitude and a request for him to deliver the action debriefing in his capacity as core field commander.
steps.female_content: The MBCC Chief played a pivotal role in this outcome, particularly in tactical command and threat assessment. EDGE has opened a special channel once again to invite ${PlayerName} to join us. This is both an expression of gratitude and a request for her to deliver the action debriefing in her capacity as core field commander.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Whenever you're ready, Chief ${PlayerName}.

The moment the neural link engages, a sharp sting pierces your temple. A wash of pale blue light sweeps across your retinas as lines of text stream, shift, and reassemble within the dataflow. Though your body hasn't left the office, your consciousness has entered a dim, empty hall.
Here, face and voice no longer matter. <color=#fb9259>SHP-13</color> is your only marker in this digital conference of minds.
[System: SHP-13 has entered the session.]

SHP-13: There isn't much to add beyond what's in the report. I assume everyone's read it. As for the root cause of all this... I need to take us back to <color=#fb9259>last August</color>.
SHP-13: During the Ash Campaign, EDGE publicly deployed the BR-003-based Black Ring weapon for the first time, using it to strike the farlands with a catastrophe-level deterrent. It put an end to the enemy's reckless use of BR-005 to draw in Apostles of Ashes against the city-state.

SHP-13: The tactic was a success. But it came at a steep price: BR-003 was exposed. This, of course, didn't slip past the Underground, and they've been on the hunt ever since.

SHP-13: Since last September, we've tracked 19 rounds of anomalous activity across the Black Ring ruins. Started with single-site strikes, then the scope kept expanding. Now every observation station's getting harassed.
SHP-13: We've been able to fend them off, but let's be clear, attacks at this level aren't their real objective. And beyond the surface ruins, the enemy's been ramping up intelligence operations as well.
You pause for a moment.
SHP-13: The Underground wants BR-003. Should they succeed... I believe everyone at this meeting knows what that entails better than I do.
After a stretch of silence, a line of text not your own lights up before your eyes.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-03:</color> What do you propose?

SHP-13: I'll keep doing my job. But staying on the defensive like this only gives them more chances to test us. And right now, we don't have the capability to hunt them down, and we won't for the foreseeable future either.
SHP-13: So I've got just one suggestion. Or rather, one request.
SHP-13: You can deploy me and all my combat units. Attach me to whichever department you see fit. All I want is to eliminate that Black Ring and neutralize the threat, as fast as possible.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07:</color><size=50> Objection.</size>
A response fires back with near-zero delay, as if on pure reflex. You knew there'd be interference.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07:</color> Once a Black Ring is suppressed and eliminated, its Mania signature changes completely. The residual contamination left in the ruins becomes virtually useless for trace study, and we've already exhausted what little value was there. As for BR-000, its Mania is far too violent. It lacks viable research conditions.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07:</color> That leaves only <color=#FFBC6F>BR-003</color>.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07:</color> Its properties are one of a kind. It's the only Secondary Black Ring humanity can reliably keep under stable control. The research value is incalculable. We've already sunk massive investment into a full control and monitoring infrastructure. The experimental environment it offers, the material samples, the data stream... all of it is indispensable for studying Black Rings, Mania, the DisSea, and even the global catastrophe patterns. It's—

SHP-13: The threat it poses is just as incalculable. You're telling me that because we can study a Black Ring, we should overlook the fact that it's still a top-tier Mania catastrophe waiting to happen?
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07:</color> You—

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-03:</color> Let us keep this rational, everyone. 07 is simply upholding their responsibility, presenting the scientific perspective, nothing more. This is standard EDGE discourse. No need to be so tense.
Another designation intervenes at just the right moment, extinguishing the spark of argument before it catches, and smoothly takes the floor.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-03:</color> To summarize: Representative 07 votes against SHP-13's proposal. Correct?
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07:</color> ...Yes. I object.

SHP-13: ......
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-03:</color> Then let's return to the original order. 04, your position?

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-04:</color> ...We take SHP-13's concerns seriously. From the moment this was first raised, we've conducted thorough internal assessments of every detail.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-04:</color> BR-003 is positioned above the city-state. For such an aerial Black Ring, suppression at that altitude presents extreme difficulty and prohibitive cost.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-04:</color> Should anything go wrong during the operation, a Mania overflow at that height means contamination raining down onto the city-state below. Containment would be next to impossible, and for cleanup, we'd be looking at astronomical figures.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07:</color> <color=#FFBC6F><size=42>Yes. We've run those projections.</color></size>
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07:</color> This isn't a combat mission. It's an extraordinarily complex, multi-layered operation.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-04:</color> And based on current data, 003 is small in size. Whether it could even be converted into a stable, extractable mine after suppression is highly uncertain. High cost, low return. Its input-to-output ratio simply doesn't compare to the West District's second mine.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-04:</color> Post-war finances are strained. Development on the second mine has been stalled repeatedly. Meanwhile, the farlands are aggressively exploring BR-005. That's already putting real competitive pressure on DisCity.

options: Is this an assessment based on Nirvana's interests?

steps.content: EDGE-04: ...I'd ask that we approach this discussion rationally. EDGE-04 oversees strategic resource planning for the city-state's core operations. And DisCity has always stood on the frontlines against catastrophes. Keeping it stable and well-resourced is a necessity for our civilization to endure. EDGE-04: At this stage, resources and focus must be directed toward projects with a demonstrable return trajectory. That is the objective, rational course.

Objective. Rational. What a tidy way to frame it. Nirvana's greed for the West District's mine has been showing its teeth for a while now. Or maybe everyone present is perfectly aware, and the mask was never really on.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-05:</color> Thank you for your contribution, 04. If I may, I'll speak now.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-05:</color> I trust your judgment, Chief. You are among our most essential frontline assets. Dependable, perceptive, and never one to mince words. The Underground poses a genuine threat. I won't dispute that.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-05:</color> But the city-state faces more than one threat.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-05:</color> The war has only just ended. The international landscape is anything but stable. Fraser's alliance with the Underground has already proven, quite vividly, the reach the farlands can have.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-05:</color> And until the 9th Agency's foreign intelligence network is fully rebuilt, we have no way of knowing how many other city-states have been tempted down that same path, quietly aiding the enemy of humanity behind closed doors.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-05:</color> Peace is a delicate thing. We all know the farlands have stayed their hand for one reason alone: the deterrent of BR-003.

options: ...But DisCity has its own military now.

steps.content:
SHP-13: Nirvana Port, the Shattered Blade... General Augustus is back. The city-state has more than enough conventional strength to defend itself.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-05:</color> But trust and alignment between us still need time to mature.

EDGE-05: The general has turned down a great many of our overtures. We had hoped the trust the two of you share might put her more at ease, that this meeting might see full attendance, given it was you who initiated this proposal. EDGE-05: A pity. [System: EDGE-08 Absent]

SHP-13: She's just out tracking down her troops. Before she left, she made it clear that the Shattered Blade stands behind whatever I decide.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-05:</color> Yes, she did say that, didn't she. Then let the record show one vote in favor from External Affairs Representative 08.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-05:</color> You see? The general remains as free-spirited as ever. Doesn't even bother to conceal a position this significant. She'll need time to grow into these responsibilities.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-05:</color> And until that time comes, we have no choice but to keep our cards close and protect ourselves. Wouldn't you agree?
With a Black Ring?

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-05:</color> I must apologize, SHP-13. At this juncture, my vote is one of opposition. But please don't read that as a withdrawal of support.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-05:</color> BR-003's fate will rest in your hands, in due course. And while we await the opportune moment, your efforts will not go unacknowledged. All necessary support to counter the Underground—intelligence, funding, resources—will be made available to you. Manpower, too, of course. I trust we're in agreement on that?
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-05:</color> Representative <color=#fb9259>06</color>?
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-06:</color> I have no objections. Whatever this meeting decides, I will see it through.
One yes, three no, one abstention... There it is again.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-03:</color> Well then. Representatives 04 through 08 have cast their votes. That leaves us.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-03:</color> SHP-13, your proposal is now under formal deliberation. This is no routine undertaking. Should a weapon-grade Black Ring be modified, suppressed, or eliminated, the ramifications extend well beyond fiscal, security, and infrastructure concerns. They demand a comprehensive reassessment of the city-state's entire strategic posture. We must first hear from our specialists.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-03:</color> Representative 07, please present your analysis from a professional standpoint.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07:</color> Understood.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07:</color> In consideration of everyone's time, I'll begin with a simplified summary, followed by supporting data in detail. My assessment will cover the following areas: BR-003's characteristics and current status, contamination risk evaluation, existing facility conditions, projected costs, and several related factors.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07:</color> First—

SHP-13: I know how these so-called scientific assessments work. You start with the conclusion you want, then build your evidence around it. We've all seen this before.

SHP-13: And I know BR-003 is tied directly to the core projects of your <color=#dg1f1f>research representative</color>, 07. They've been the most vocal advocate for preserving it from the start. An evaluation weighed down by that kind of vested interest isn't going to convince me. They're just here to recite the objections you've already settled on.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07:</color> <size=60>Everything I say here has always been in service of my position and my responsibilities!</size>
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02:</color> Heh... Alright, alright. Let's all take a deep breath and keep things rational, shall we?

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02:</color> As a guest we invited, SHP-13 might be unfamiliar with how we conduct things. But for EDGE members, rationality is the only standard by which we speak and decide.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02:</color> And we must model that standard for our collaborator as well, mustn't we?

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07:</color> ......Yes.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02:</color> Representative 07's report will be compiled for you afterward, in a more accessible format. I do hope it earns your trust.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02:</color> But before all that, I'd like to hear your perspective. What is your intention for BR-003? Whose forces do you envision deploying? And the approach? Will it be a small elite strike team going in?
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02:</color> I recall you've often said you'd rather not drag ordinary personnel into the hazards of a Black Ring. So then...

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02:</color> Are you planning to resolve this yourself... to devour it with your shackles?
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02:</color> Wouldn't that be... too risky?
The questions are softly delivered, but they trigger a spike of wariness in you.

SHP-13: Of course I'll need support. FAC assets externally, maybe even the Ring Research Institute. Internally, assistance from the Sinners. I'll use my shackles to keep their contamination stabilized as best I can. And naturally, I'll submit the full operational plan for EDGE review. SHP-13: If what you're worried about is me losing control once I'm inside the Black Ring, well, you're free to invoke those Rules you planted in me.

SHP-13: Isn't that the very reason EDGE is willing to trust me in the first place?
SHP-13: Your only purpose in using me is to <color=#fb9259>fight Mania</color>, isn't it? So what's there to hesitate about?

SHP-13: In this city-state, every soldier fighting on the front lines, every person living under the shadow of the DisSea... they bear these risks every single day.
SHP-13: Because a Black Ring hangs right above their heads, and the Underground has been waiting for their chance. Mania is the greatest threat civilization faces. And if there were a chance to eliminate it, countless people would act without hesitation, whatever the cost.
SHP-13: And yet...

SHP-13: The highest decision-makers, out of all people, are the ones dragging their feet?
SHP-13: A <color=#fb9259>testing site</color>, a <color=#fb9259>mine</color>, a <color=#fb9259>war weapon</color>... are these really worth more to you than Mania and the disasters it causes?
[EDGE Briefing Hall, Transition 2s]
The entire meeting goes silent for two seconds. No text, only stillness. Then another channel, one that has never spoken, flickers to life.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01:</color> You seem rather worked up, Chief. Are things truly that pressing?

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01:</color> EDGE is not your enemy. That said, we all have our limitations. That's precisely why we divide seats and responsibilities to complement one another. It's also why we invited you here.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01:</color> I imagine you're often privy to... certain information. The kind most people cannot access, or perhaps cannot comprehend, even.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01:</color> Have you uncovered something that has you this uneasy?
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01:</color> If there's any intelligence, you can share it freely. We are prepared to assist in analysis and help you find answers.

SHP-13: ............
Don't say it.
[Small CG: Nightmare]
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01:</color> Chief?
Control your mind. Don't say a word.

SHP-13: ...Anything I can share is already in my reports. Recent operations have put me on alert, yes, but it's nothing concrete. It's more of a... battlefield instinct. That's all it is.
SHP-13: My gut tells me...
It is true, after all. You don't have any solid intel to offer them.
...You've only had a strange dream.
Your mind hasn't quite grasped what those fragments signify yet, but something deep inside already warns you—
It's dangerous. Don't tell anyone.
[Reuse Nightmare]

steps.speaker: Strange Voice
steps.content: I thought I'd go my whole life without ever laying eyes on you again... and yet here you are. Guess I owe that thing called fate a word of thanks.

steps.speaker: Strange Voice
steps.content: Still... now that you've shown up, should I take it you're here to stand in my way? Or did you come to snatch something for yourself?

steps.speaker: Strange Voice
steps.content: Hehehe...
[Eyes Snap Open]
Your eyes snap open. You lift your head and find yourself staring into the open sky.

Beyond the window stretches an endless blue sky dotted with white clouds. It is at the very same height as in the dream, though BR-003 is nowhere in sight. Without realizing it... you let out a breath you didn't know you were holding.
...Another dream.

The frustrating "work" and unsettling premonitions weave together into nightmares that bleed you dry, stealing every moment of rest. Sleeping has become more exhausting than staying awake. You should find a way to vent, to release it all, but—

Softly, the sound of trickling water reaches your ears. A familiar, subtle fragrance drifts with it, stroking your nerves, until, little by little, you feel the afternoon sunlight warming your skin again.
A page turns, the whisper of it brushing past the fine hair at your temple, gently calling your eyes toward it.
[Enter CG: Celine First Meeting]
The woman murmurs the words on the page, her voice hushed and rhythmic, like poetry spoken to no one in particular.
"Time stops for no soul, as the river will not linger. And when you wake, the fleeting light of bygone days drifts away like a dream..."
Her voice, gentle as the poetry it carries, fades into silence. She shuts the book softly and looks your way.
Ah, you're finally awake. You look positively worn down. Was the EDGE meeting truly so trying?
If you'd care to share, I'm more than happy to listen. Recording and analysis have always been my specialty, as you well know.
Her smile, steady and familiar, always settles something inside you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Of course. I need your help.

DisCity Central Library
Head Librarian Celine Fabius

An S-Class Sinner originating from Paradeisos. Her case file was officially transferred to the MBCC and processed just two weeks ago.
Ability: Memory Maniafication.
